Name: IdaIda's Seasonal Flooring and Paths (for CP and AT)
Author: idaida
Description:
[center][color=#b4a7d6][url=https://www.patreon.com/idaida][img]https://i.imgur.com/A5ZwJYT.png[/img][/url]
This mod replaces the craftable floors and paths. The new floors and paths are seasonal, so some colors will change a little. This mod is made to combine well with my other mods.

Atm I made the grass path recolors that match Vanilla, Vibrant Pastoral and Starblue Valley. The default assets in the mod are for Starblue, but assets for the other two are also included. If you want to change them, just replace the main 'assets' folder in the mod with the one you want to use. 

[url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][color=#9900ff]♡[/color][/url][color=#d9d2e9] 
[/color]
If you are using a different map reshade feel free to recolor the grass path so that it fits your game. If you do so, please [b]don't[/b] upload that as a new mod. However you can contact me and I'll be happy to include the new recolor with this og mod. 
[url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][color=#9900ff]
♡[/color][/url] 

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/95265773][color=#d9d2e9]skellady[/color][/url] for making the AT conversion![/color]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][color=#9900ff]♡[/color][/url] [color=#b4a7d6]

All the sprites in my mods are drawn by me or repurposed vanilla sprites that are recolored by me.[/color]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][color=#9900ff]♡[/color][/url]
